title: M5 benchmark-certification proof packet for every claimed performance, compatibility, and qualification row
summary: Binds every claimed M5 performance, compatibility, and qualification row to the upstream truth that backs it -- the benchmark-governance matrix, the shiproom freshness ledger, the threshold-change ledger, the corpus-intake ledger, the public-comparison reproducibility register, and the publication-ingestion register -- recomputes for each row the certification gaps that fire across corpus identity, reference-hardware basis, threshold lineage, reproducibility-pack completeness, freshness and comparability, and publication propagation, narrows the effective claim, derives the certification state, and projects the promotion verdict release, support, docs, and help consume so a claimed row cannot stay green on stale or incomparable benchmark evidence.

claim_classes.description: A latency, throughput, or startup performance row whose number rests on a protected benchmark metric, corpus, and reference hardware.
A cross-product or parity comparison row whose head-to-head claim rests on a protected benchmark metric measured identically on both sides.
A qualification or comparability row whose conclusion rests on a protected benchmark metric and is withdrawn when its comparability baseline resets.

evidence_pillars.proves: Every bound corpus carries an approved, CI-admitted intake decision with cleared licensing, redaction, and retention posture.
Every metric binds a reference-hardware profile and lab image, and no claim-bearing row rides self-capture identity.
Every metric carries an in-force threshold-change record and no in-force waiver is past its expiry.
Every governance pack binds a reproducibility pack that retains raw run metadata, is in force for its posture, and stays within its freshness window.
The run backing the claim is current and comparable on corpus revision, hardware class, lab image, threshold version, and run-metadata completeness.
The claim publication entry reaches every required publication surface so a narrowed claim cannot stay strong on a surface that stopped consuming the entry.

certification_gaps.detects: A bound corpus has no approved, CI-admitted intake decision.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: A claim resting on an un-admitted corpus is quarantined until the corpus passes intake review.

certification_gaps.detects: A bound metric has no reference-hardware profile or lab image, or a claim-bearing row rides self-capture identity.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: A benchmark number with no reference-hardware basis is not comparable and is quarantined.

certification_gaps.detects: A bound metric carries no in-force threshold-change record.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: A metric with no in-force threshold record loses its external claim until a typed change record lands.

certification_gaps.detects: An in-force threshold-change record's waiver is past its expiry.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: An expired threshold waiver loses the external claim until the waiver is renewed or the bar is recalibrated.

certification_gaps.detects: The governance pack binds no reproducibility pack.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: A claim with no reproducibility pack drops to methodology-only until a pack with raw configuration and environment metadata lands.

certification_gaps.detects: The reproducibility pack does not retain raw run metadata, is not in force for its posture, or omits a required disclosure field.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: An incomplete reproducibility pack drops the claim to methodology-only until the pack is completed.

certification_gaps.detects: The reproducibility pack is past its freshness window.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: A stale reproducibility pack drops the claim to methodology-only until the pack is refreshed.

certification_gaps.detects: The freshness ledger entry backing the row is stale.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: Stale backing evidence drops the claim to methodology-only until a fresh reference capture lands.

certification_gaps.detects: The freshness ledger entry backing the row is incomparable or missing.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: Incomparable or missing backing evidence quarantines the claim until a reset reference capture lands.

certification_gaps.detects: A required publication surface does not consume the claim publication entry.
certification_gaps.stop_rule: An entry that does not reach every required surface drops to methodology-only until propagation is restored so no surface can keep a strong claim the others narrowed.

certification_states.description: Every evidence pillar proves currency and the effective claim stands at the row's published ceiling.
At least one certification gap fired and the effective claim is below the published ceiling; a claim-bearing row in this state holds promotion.
The effective claim floored to quarantined-not-comparable; the row asserts no current claim and a claim-bearing posture narrowed this far holds promotion.

hardware_basis.detail: Bound to the macOS arm64 reference-lab profile and frozen lab image; no self-capture identity.

threshold_lineage.detail: In-force frozen-calibrated record supersedes the time-boxed easing; no active waiver.

reproducibility_pack.detail: Publishable pack retaining raw run metadata with full disclosure; within its freshness window.

promotion_blocker.certification_label: Certified Aureline-only performance claim: current corpus intake, reference hardware, in-force threshold, complete reproducibility pack, and fresh comparable evidence.

hardware_basis.detail: Bound to the macOS arm64 reference-lab profile and frozen lab image.

threshold_lineage.detail: In-force provisional-hold record; the methodology entry makes no measured claim.

rows.title: Compatibility certification for the first-useful-edit head-to-head comparison.

corpus_identity.detail: MIT/0BSD self-host workflow corpus admitted for protected CI.

hardware_basis.detail: Both sides captured on the same reference-lab profile and frozen lab image.

threshold_lineage.detail: In-force frozen-calibrated record; no active waiver.

reproducibility_pack.detail: Publishable head-to-head pack with task-parity, competitor-version, and raw-run-metadata disclosure retained.

promotion_blocker.certification_label: Certified public head-to-head comparison: identical corpus, hardware, and lab image on both sides with full disclosure and a fresh comparable capture.

rows.title: Qualification certification for the quarantined legacy first-paint comparison.

corpus_identity.detail: Corpus intake is clean; the comparability break is on the lab image, not the corpus.

hardware_basis.detail: Hardware and lab-image identity are bound; the lab image was recalibrated without a reset capture.

threshold_lineage.detail: In-force provisional-hold record; the claim is quarantined on comparability, not threshold drift.

reproducibility_pack.detail: Quarantined reproducibility pack retains raw run metadata and records why the comparison was quarantined.

freshness_comparability.detail: A lab-image recalibration reset comparability for first paint with no reset capture; the backing run is incomparable.

publication_propagation.detail: Docs, help, and support export render the quarantined state verbatim.

promotion_blocker.certification_label: Quarantined qualification row: a lab-image recalibration left the first-paint comparison incomparable; retained for diagnosis, asserts no claim, and does not hold promotion.

promotion_gate.rationale: Every claim-bearing row certifies at its published ceiling; the quarantined qualification row asserts no claim and does not hold promotion.

ingests: Each row's certification state, fired gaps, and effective claim, plus the promotion hold/proceed verdict.
Holds promotion when a claim-bearing row narrows below the posture it asserts, and renders the exact gap rather than a bare color.
Each release packet's declared certification state and effective claim, which must equal the packet's recomputed values.
A release packet cannot publish a fresher certification than the row's evidence supports.
Certification states, fired gaps, certification labels, and bound ids only.
Never raw run logs, raw machine labels, raw corpus contents, or raw provider payloads behind a row.
Effective claim and certification label per row.
A narrowed or quarantined row shows its narrowed claim and the gap, not its ceiling.

inspection.how_to_recompute: For each row, resolve the bound corpus-intake decisions, governance metric hardware and lab bindings, in-force threshold-change records, reproducibility pack, freshness ledger entry, and publication surfaces; fire each certification gap whose condition holds; set the effective claim to the lowest-ranked of the published ceiling, the freshness entry's effective claim, and each fired gap's narrows_to; and derive the state as quarantined when the claim floors, narrowed when below the ceiling, else certified.
inspection.promotion_gate: Promotion holds when any claim-bearing row's effective claim is below the posture it asserts; methodology and quarantined rows assert no claim and never hold promotion on their own.
inspection.claim_class_coverage: Performance, compatibility, and qualification claim classes are each certified by at least one row, so the lane certifies benchmark evidence integrity across every claimed M5 row class rather than performance alone.
